response.text: Column names are uppercase, so I need to quote every one of them.

arguments.sql: select h."JRNL_NO", sum(l."DR_AMT") dr, sum(l."CR_AMT") cr from "GLJRNH" h join "GLJRNL" l on l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" group by h."JRNL_NO" having sum(l."DR_AMT")<>sum(l."CR_AMT")

select h."JRNL_NO",h."PRD_ID",h."POST_DT",h."SRC_CD",h."SRC_REF",h."REF_JRNL_NO",h."MEMO",p."STRT_DT",p."END_DT",p."CLOSE_DT" from "GLJRNH" h join "GLPERD" p on p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" where h."POST_DT" not between p."STRT_DT" and p."END_DT" or h."POST_DT">coalesce(p."CLOSE_DT",99999999) or h."REF_JRNL_NO" is not null

select l."JRNL_NO",l."LN_SEQ",l."ACCT_CD",l."DR_AMT",l."CR_AMT",h."SRC_CD",h."POST_DT" from "GLJRNL" l join "GLJRNH" h on h."JRNL_NO"=l."JRNL_NO" where trim(l."ACCT_CD")='5900' or trim(l."ACCT_CD") not in (select trim("ACCT_CD") from "GLCOA")
